sources.title: American Tourism in Israel Procedure – January 2025 Update
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Government of Israel procedure specifically regulates entry, documents, permits and crossings for United States citizens recorded as Palestinian residents in the Israeli Population Registry.
sources.supportingExcerpt: his entry will be permitted and he will not be eligible for a permit/visa to Israel.

conflicts.officialStatus: unresolved: registry, residence, document, permit, crossing and individual-screening treatment; no passport-wide ordinary-visitor rule published
conflicts.explanation: The fallback's advance-visa label would flatten a current official regime that distinguishes Palestinian registry status, foreign passports, Palestinian documentation, permits and crossings. The reviewed authorities do not establish a current ordinary Palestinian-passport short-visitor classification or issuance timing.

unresolved.reason: No current accessible Israeli primary source supplies a passport-wide ordinary Palestinian-passport short-visitor rule or issuance timing. The reviewed regime is instead conditional on population-registry or residence status, Palestinian or foreign documents, permits, crossings and individual screening; those routes must not be normalized as visa_required.
